collection.title: Vauxhall Zafira 2005 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Zafira 2005 to 2014 model requires a 28" wiper blade for the drivers and a 22" on the passengers side with a Pinch Tab arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Zafira which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
